label: LinkedIn
terms_note: LinkedIn API Terms of Use §3.1 prohibits automating posting outside the approved Community Management API; §4.1 forbids storing member Content beyond the permitted window — publish only from an approved app, keep no copies of other members’ posts.

tools.name: publish_image
tools.endpoint: POST rest/images?action=initializeUpload → PUT uploadUrl → POST rest/posts with the image URN

tools.name: publish_video
tools.endpoint: POST https://api.linkedin.com/rest/videos?action=initializeUpload → PUT part(s) → POST rest/videos?action=finalizeUpload → POST rest/posts

tools.name: dm_send
tools.endpoint: — (no public messaging API; Messages API is limited to specific partner programs)

auth: 1. Developer Portal app → apply for the **Community Management API** (open to all approved developers). Every app
2. 3-legged OAuth 2.0 authorization code; scopes `w_member_social` (member posts), `w_organization_social` (Page posts;
3. Access tokens live 60 days; refresh tokens (programmatic refresh) for approved partners.

endpoints.call: Images API `POST /rest/images?action=initializeUpload` → PUT bytes; Videos API, Documents API

reference.limits: - Development-tier caps above; 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS otherwise unpublished. - Organic carousels unsupported; article posts need explicit title / description / thumbnail (no URL scraping). - No scheduling parameter. Scraping or automating member sessions outside the API violates the User Agreement — LinkedIn is API-only or human (never browser automation).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client id of a LinkedIn app with the Community Management API product (scopes w_organization_social, r_organization_social, plus openid profile for me).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's client secret (form body of the refresh_token grant at https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Programmatic refresh token from the 3-legged flow (approved Marketing/Community Management partners; valid about one year). The runtime mints 60-day access tokens from it.

config_fields.name: author_urn
config_fields.help: Organization URN the member administers and acts as, e.g. urn:li:organization:5515715 (comment actor and the organizationalEntity of read_mentions).

me.note: OpenID Connect userinfo (sub, name, email) of the member behind the token; needs the openid and profile scopes.

read_comments.note: `post_id` is the share/ugcPost URN (urn:li:share:… or urn:li:ugcPost:…). id is the commentUrn to pass to reply_comment; created_at is epoch milliseconds.

reply_comment.note: Nested comment: `comment_id` is the parent commentUrn urn:li:comment:(urn:li:activity:…,…); the reply is authored by config author_urn. The docs' nested sample also sends `object` (the post URN), which this call cannot derive from the comment id.

read_mentions.note: Mentions of the organization (config author_urn) in posts; raw.generatedActivity is the mentioning share URN and raw.sourcePost the activity. No text or author is returned; `since` is not sent.

delete.note: `post_id` must be the URL-ENCODED share/ugcPost URN (urn%3Ali%3Ashare%3A123), as in 'DELETE https://api.linkedin.com/rest/posts/{encoded ugcPostUrn|shareUrn}'. 'Post deletions are idempotent' (204).

analytics_post.note: Social metadata of a share/ugcPost/comment URN: metrics carries reactionSummaries (per reaction type counts), commentSummary {count, topLevelCount} and commentsState.

not_offered.publish_text: POST /rest/posts answers 201 with the Post id only in a header: 'the response header x-restli-id contains the Post ID' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/posts-api); the runtime maps response bodies only, so the required `id` could not be returned.
not_offered.publish_image: An image post first needs 'uploading an image asset to obtain an Image URN (urn:li:image:{id})' via the Images API (initializeUpload, then PUT the bytes) before POST /rest/posts (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/marketing/community-management/shares/images-api) — not a single call.

evidence: host api.linkedin.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 6/6 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
